name: bitmovin-encoding-live
description: Portable Bitmovin live encoding skill packaged for Codex as a local plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Create and start a Bitmovin live encoding (RTMP / redundant RTMP / SRT)
interface.longDescription: Walks the user through creating and starting a Bitmovin live encoding end-to-end via the Encoding Templates API and the Bitmovin Python SDK. Renders Jinja templates from a small parameter file, validates against the published Encoding Template JSON schema, submits and polls until the encoder is RUNNING, and prints ingest URL + manifest URLs. Covers RTMP (single + redundant) and SRT (LISTENER / CALLER, optional AES passphrase).
defaultPrompt: Set up a Bitmovin live encoding for RTMP ingest
Start a redundant-RTMP live encoding on Bitmovin
Start an SRT live encoding on Bitmovin
